answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One name, one proof, one entry: Helmbound vair stamper mantle seal enforces it, and a seal vair stampers renew after herald office hearings is how the check runs. The window charges £22 in fees and a 3-day delay before the stamp dries before it opens, and the bridge is that the fee never comes back. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The clerk notes ferrous. Every echo is counted once.
